messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Furosemide may slow breast milk production.
Triplet: ["Furosemide", "may affect", "breast milk production"]

The relation 'may affect' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may influence or alter the physiological process or condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'acts in': The subject drug exerts its effects within the anatomical or physiological system specified by the object entity.
B. 'improves': The subject drug enhances or positively affects the condition or parameter specified by the object entity.
C. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
D. 'has dose adjustment instruction': The subject drug may require changes in dosage based on the condition or factor specified in the object entity.
E. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
